Classify uploads must pass a JPEG, PNG or WebP magic-byte check before sharp reads them, Cloudflare blocks /_next/image, and Next's image optimizer has its own patched copy. Upgrading the app's sharp changes the image pipeline that the classification release evidence is bound to, so it ships with the next paid evidence run: the TokenHub international migration.
No patched braces release exists. It is reached only at build time, through Tailwind CSS 3 and @next/eslint-plugin-next, which expand glob patterns from this repository and never untrusted input.
